0022600135.text: The Philadelphia 76ers (3-1, 1st in the Atlantic, 2nd in the East) arrive for their fifth game of the season after a loss in their last outing, while the Indiana Pacers (2-1, 5th in the East, 2nd in the Central, one game back) come in on a one-game win streak. Philadelphia is missing Joel Embiid, VJ Edgecombe, Ariel Hukporti, Dominick Barlow, Jabari Walker and Tacko Fall, and Indiana is without Ben Sheppard and Johnny Furphy. The 76ers won all four meetings in the 2025-26 season series and beat Indiana 105-94 in Indianapolis on April 10, 2026, and no games have been played yet in the 2026-27 series.
